label: sdc01_0420_sister_01
text: We’re like the ogre and its masks—we help bring\nout each other’s full power![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_02
text: And there it is! We got the last mask![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_03
text: Congratulations, Ogerpon! And good work,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]! We’ve got all the masks![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_04
text: Thank goodness... It all worked out—right,\nOgerpon?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_brother_02
text: Well, uh...I...I wanted to ask a favor...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0420_brother_03
text: I wanted you to come to the village. An’ bring\nthe ogre with you...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0420_brother_04
text: You gotta trust me. It’ll be OK. I promise...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0420_brother_05
text: Th-that’s all I wanted to ask! Just come![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_06
text: I wonder what’s gotten into him. Everyone in the\nvillage thinks that Ogerpon’s a menace, right?\r\nI hope he knows what he’s doing...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_07
text: But he did have a confident look in his eyes![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_08
text: Let’s trust Kiki and head to the village.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0420_sister_09
text: If things go south, I’ll use my natural charm to\nsmooth things over![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
